data.one_liner: Flutter compass plugin offering true heading, accuracy, and calibration needs.
data.what_it_does: Provides reliable compass data streams including heading relative to true north, sensor accuracy, and calibration requirements. It supports Android and iOS platforms.
use_when: You need to display true heading or orientation relative to north in your app.
You want to check if the device compass needs calibration.
avoid_when: You are running tests exclusively on iOS simulators, which cannot use the heading sensor.
Your app requires heading support in landscape orientation, as heading currently only supports portrait mode.
strengths: Provides accuracy metrics and calibration indicators.
Stream-based API integrates easily with Flutter widgets.
weaknesses: Heading currently supports only portrait mode.
Requires real device testing as iOS simulators cannot use the heading sensor.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting minimum SDK (iOS 12, Android 21), configuring location permissions via permission_handler and AndroidManifest.xml for Android, and fixing device orientation to portrait.

alternatives.name: sensors_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides access to standard device sensors like accelerometer, magnetometer, gyroscope, and user accelerometer.
